reflex.name: LI4 · Hegu
reflex.note: Ramo superficial do nervo radial; 1º interósseo dorsal.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: PC6 · Neiguan
reflex.note: Entre os tendões do palmar longo e do flexor radial do carpo, sobre o nervo mediano.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: HT7 · Shenmen
reflex.note: Prega do punho, lado ulnar, radial ao flexor ulnar do carpo.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: ST36 · Zusanli
reflex.note: 3 cun abaixo da patela, um dedo lateral à crista tibial; ramo profundo do fibular.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: SP6 · Sanyinjiao
reflex.note: 3 cun acima do maléolo medial, atrás da borda medial da tíbia.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: GB34 · Yanglingquan
reflex.note: Anterior e inferior à cabeça da fíbula, sobre o nervo fibular comum.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: LR3 · Taichong
reflex.note: Dorso do pé, entre o 1º e o 2º metatarsos (ramo profundo do fibular).
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: BL40 · Weizhong
reflex.note: Centro da fossa poplítea, sobre o nervo tibial.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: GV20 · Baihui
reflex.note: Vértice do crânio, na linha média.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: CV12 · Zhongwan
reflex.note: Linha média, entre o processo xifoide e o umbigo.
reflex.ref: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region. Manila: WHO WPRO; 2008.

reflex.name: Cymba conchae (ABVN)
reflex.note: Inervação 100 % pelo ramo auricular do vago: alvo da taVNS.
reflex.ref: Peuker ET, Filler TJ. The nerve supply of the human auricle. Clin Anat. 2002;15(1):35-7.

reflex.name: Lóbulo (controle sham)
reflex.note: Sem ABVN (nervo auricular magno, C2–C3): local de estimulação simulada.
reflex.ref: Peuker ET, Filler TJ. The nerve supply of the human auricle. Clin Anat. 2002;15(1):35-7.

reflex.name: Trapézio superior (TrP1)
reflex.refers: Têmpora, ângulo da mandíbula e região posterolateral do pescoço
reflex.note: Inervação motora pelo nervo acessório (XI), não modelado.
reflex.ref: Simons DG, Travell JG, Simons LS. Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual. 2nd ed. Baltimore: Williams & Wilkins; 1999.

reflex.name: Glúteo médio (TrP1)
reflex.ref: Simons DG, Travell JG, Simons LS. Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual. 2nd ed. Baltimore: Williams & Wilkins; 1999.

reflex.name: Quadrado lombar (TrP)
reflex.ref: Simons DG, Travell JG, Simons LS. Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual. 2nd ed. Baltimore: Williams & Wilkins; 1999.

reflex.name: Coração → T1–T4 (tórax e face medial do braço esquerdo)
reflex.refers: Precórdio, ombro e face medial do braço esquerdo
reflex.ref: Head H. On disturbances of sensation with especial reference to the pain of visceral disease. Brain. 1893;16:1-133.

reflex.name: Estômago → T6–T9 (epigástrio)
reflex.note: Aferências viscerais pelos nervos esplâncnicos maiores.
reflex.ref: Head H. On disturbances of sensation with especial reference to the pain of visceral disease. Brain. 1893;16:1-133.

reflex.name: Vesícula biliar → T7–T9 (hipocôndrio direito)
reflex.refers: Hipocôndrio direito e ponta da escápula direita
reflex.ref: Head H. On disturbances of sensation with especial reference to the pain of visceral disease. Brain. 1893;16:1-133.

reflex.name: Rim → T10–L1 (flanco)
reflex.refers: Flanco e região lombar, irradiando para a virilha
reflex.ref: Head H. On disturbances of sensation with especial reference to the pain of visceral disease. Brain. 1893;16:1-133.

reflex.name: Apêndice → T10 (periumbilical, fase inicial)
reflex.refers: Região periumbilical; depois fossa ilíaca direita (peritônio parietal)
reflex.ref: Head H. On disturbances of sensation with especial reference to the pain of visceral disease. Brain. 1893;16:1-133.
